methods.description: Test that verifies client registration and unregistration upon disconnection.

methods.name: shouldRegisterClientAndUnregisterItWhenDestructed
methods.description: Test that verifies client registration and unregistration upon object destruction.

methods.description: Test that verifies successful retrieval of shared memory.
